hints.title: Single Deletion Disjunction
hints.text: When moving inward from both ends, matching characters can be skipped. At the first character mismatch, at most one deletion is permitted: delete either the left or the right character.

hints.title: Subproblem Symmetry Invariant
hints.text: Skipping either the character at the left index or the right index yields two candidate inner substrings, at least one of which must be a strict palindrome.

hints.title: Branching Inward Check Procedure
hints.text: Initialize pointers at 0 and length minus one. While left is less than right and characters match, advance inward. Upon finding a mismatch, verify whether the substring from left plus one to right is a palindrome, or the substring from left to right minus one is a palindrome. Return true if either holds.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying every possible single-character deletion creates N substrings and tests each in O(N) time, leading to an O(N^2) quadratic runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Advancing two pointers inward and branching at the first mismatch checks at most two linear passes, taking O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that branching happens at most once, maintaining linear time complexity.
